title: Room booking policy
text: Employees may reserve a meeting room up to 14 days in advance. A booking must not exceed the published room capacity. The organizer must cancel a reservation when the meeting is cancelled.

title: Accessible workplace tools
text: The room selection and reservation flow must support keyboard navigation. Availability and error messages must not rely on color alone. Room accessibility features must be visible before confirmation.

title: Reservation confirmation standard
text: A successful reservation must show the room name, start time, end time, and organizer. If a room becomes unavailable before confirmation, the reservation must fail with an actionable message.
